title: Single-Crystal Superstructures via Hierarchical Assemblies of Giant Rubik’s Cubes as Tertiary Building Units

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Pr–Sb oxohalide superstructure containing discrete {Pr4Sb12} clusters and cubic superclusters

material_class.structural_family: Discrete cubic oxohalide superclusters coexisting with discrete {Pr4Sb12} clusters

synthesis.procedure: The main article describes solvothermal assembly in a mixture of 2-methylpyridine and water but refers to the Supporting Information for preparation details.

properties.summary: Magnetic susceptibility indicates paramagnetic behavior down to 2 K. The article also reports an optical absorption edge.

measurements.name: Lowest temperature without an observed susceptibility peak

source_locations.location: Properties discussion; Figures S17 and S16 cited

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete cubic supercluster assembled from eight {Pr4Sb12} oxohalide units coexists with a discrete {Pr4Sb12} cluster in a 1:1 ratio.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Pr–Sb oxohalide superstructure of discrete cubic superclusters

synthesis.procedure: The main article describes solvothermal assembly in a mixture of 2-methylpyridine and water but refers to the Supporting Information for preparation details.

properties.summary: An optical absorption edge is reported.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: All {Pr4Sb12} secondary building units aggregate into discrete cubic superclusters; unlike compound 1, no separate {Pr4Sb12} clusters coexist in the crystal.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Pr–Sb oxohalide superstructure with discrete cubic superclusters and two-dimensional layers

material_class.structural_family: Coexisting discrete cubic superclusters and interconnected two-dimensional supercluster layers

synthesis.procedure: The main article describes solvothermal assembly in a mixture of 2-methylpyridine and water but refers to the Supporting Information for preparation details.

properties.summary: An optical absorption edge is reported.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: One set of cubic superclusters interconnects through Pr–Cl–Pr and Sb–O–Cl connections into uneven two-dimensional layers, while another set remains discrete. The layers and arrays of discrete cubes alternate along the crystallographic c-axis.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Three-dimensional Pr–Sb oxohalide framework of rhombic cubic superclusters

material_class.structural_family: Three-dimensional open framework of interconnected rhombic cubic superclusters

synthesis.procedure: The main article describes solvothermal assembly in a mixture of 2-methylpyridine and water but refers to the Supporting Information for preparation details.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Eight {Pr4Sb12} units form a rhombic cubic supercluster with two hexacyanoferrate and four acetate linkers. Each supercluster connects to eight neighboring superclusters through Pr–O–Pr connections, forming a three-dimensional open framework.
